subject: LumenSoft: urgent short-term trial extension & credit reinstatement request
messages:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah@lumensoft.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumensoft.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial credits — request to reopen expired balance

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from our side — we were supposed to start an integration sprint last month but procurement got delayed and our sandbox sat idle. I just noticed the trial credits expired (we're still mid-eval) and the team can't finish a key integration without a short runway.

I've attached a one-page usage snapshot that shows we only consumed ~12% of the intended pilot estimate. Can you help us with a short one-time reinstatement or extension (2 weeks) so we can finish the proof-of-concept?

If needed I can loop in our procurement manager (cc'd). We're trying to avoid re-procurement and would appreciate a pragmatic one-off.

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Patel
Head of Platform, LumenSoft
[screenshot: trial-usage-snapshot.csv attached]

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and the snapshot.

Sorry to hear procurement timing blocked your sprint. We're happy to evaluate a limited, one-time make-good to get you the runway to finish the integration. To move quickly I need sign-off from finance/ops for crediting policy and Ben for manager approval.

Proposed approach (quick, internal):
- Offer a one-time credit equal to 25k tokens (roughly matches the remaining eval runway you described).
- Set expiration for the credit to 14 days from issuance.
- Mark this as a one-time exception tied to deal LS-5423; finance will create an offsetting credit note.

Ben/Naomi — could you confirm if 25k is acceptable and whether finance needs any paperwork before we push the credit? If you prefer a different cap, say 20k–30k, let me know.

Sarah — if approved I can apply the credit today and will follow up with a short checklist to make sure you have access to the higher throughput configuration for the duration.

Best,
Marissa
